positions.title: Graduate Developer
positions.description:
At my time in PCS I worked with a team of developers on a advertising sales and customer management platform having engaged in full stack development. Here I gained practical experience in; Javascript, Node js, CSS3, HTML 5, Backbone js, Sails Js server-side framework and version control with Git.
Through this role I have completed training in client side development (Sencha Ext JS) and server side development (Postgres relational database)

projects.title: The Design and Development of A Geo Location Social Application
projects.description: As part of a final year project, I challenged myself into creating a prototype Android mobile application. This app was built around an existing web api with use of different locational technologies explored. Bluetooth Beacons and geofencing
